    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for a successful validation of subscription initiation for a user with a valid plan.")
    @pytest.mark.priority(7)
    def test_zlets_subscribe(self):
        allure.dynamic.title(
        "Given a user has a valid subscription plan, "
        "When the user initiates a subscription, "
        "Then the subscription should start successfully and navigated back to the app to see subscription successful popup page"
    )
        headers = {
            "Authorization": "Token token=" + config.get_auth_token(),
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/exercises"
        request_payload = load_request_payload("WebApp/createExerciseData.json")
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(request_payload))
        assert response.status_code == 403, f"Expected 403 Forbidden, got {response.status_code}"
        response_data = response.json()
        print(f"Response data: {response_data}")
        assert "error" in response_data, "Response should contain an 'error' key"
        assert response_data["error"] == "Subscription required to access this resource.", \
            f"Expected error message 'Subscription required to access this resource.', got {response_data['error']}"
    
        #let's unblock the user by subscribing to a plan
        headers, auth_token = self.createSession(config.get_login_credentials()['webStripeUsername'], config.get_login_credentials()['webStripeUserPassword'])
    
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/payments/initiate"
        payload = json.dumps({
            "product_id": "prod_SWidazoJUaBgio",
            "provider": "stripe",
            "options": {}
            })
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload)
        assert response.status_code == 200, f"Failed to initiate payment. Status code: {response.status_code}"
        print("Response content:", response.text)
    
        payment_data = response.json()
        checkout_url = payment_data.get("checkout_url")
    
    
    
        # _, auth_token = self.createSession(config.get_login_credentials()['usernameCoach_1'], config.get_login_credentials()['passwordCoach_1'])
        assert auth_token is not None, "Failed to create session"
    
        chrome_options = Options()
        chrome_options.add_argument("--headless")
        chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1920,1080")
